title: Motivating factors for young professionals involved in information systems projects
core_idea: Examine what motivates young information systems (IS) professionals who join IS project teams—often transitioning from university into roles such as external consultants—by using a qualitative survey of master's students involved in a project-based learning course, with the goal of informing IS project performance and education/training.
tldr: A qualitative study designed to identify motivating factors for young IS professionals in project teams, using master's students in a project-based course to inform practice and training.
